KataGo python modules vendored for the C10 PREREG_07 (competition 2, KataGo HumanSL) pilot.

Upstream repository : https://github.com/lightvector/KataGo
Upstream commit     : d91ea855110dae533f0aada947b2b7d78cc8a4e1 (commit date 2026-09-27 20:12:18 -0400, master HEAD at clone time)
Copied on           : 2026-10-02 (Asia/Taipei)
Licence             : LICENSE (MIT-style, repository root) and python/katago/train/LICENSE_AND_AUTHORS (MIT, transformer parts);
                      authors listed in CONTRIBUTORS. Both files are copied unmodified next to the code.
Network weights     : NOT vendored. b18c384nbt-humanv0.ckpt (KataGo v1.15.0 release asset, 323,752,318 bytes) is kept
                      git-ignored under data/katago/; its licence is https://katagotraining.org/network_license/ .

How the files were copied
  Each file was written with `git cat-file blob HEAD:<path>` from a shallow clone of the commit above, so the bytes are
  the upstream git blob (LF line endings), not the Windows checkout (core.autocrlf=true gave CRLF in the clone).
  No file was modified. Verify with `git hash-object --no-filters <file>` against the blob id below.
  Anything we need to change lives in our own code (results/prereg07/explore/pilot_humansl/hs_lib.py), never here.

Why these files
  game/board.py, game/features.py      : KataGo's python Board (simple ko only, no superko) and input featurisation
                                         (22 spatial planes + 19 globals for model versions 10-17).
  game/sgfmetadata.py                  : the 192-channel SGF metadata row (rank, time control, date, source).
  game/gamestate.py                    : KataGo's own single-position inference path; used only as the parity reference.
  train/model_pytorch.py, modelconfigs.py, trainloop_helpers.py (env_flag), load_model.py : the PyTorch model and loader.
  humanslnet_server.py                 : KataGo's own HumanSL stdin/stdout server; the parity test runs it unchanged as a
                                         subprocess (batch 1, CPU).
Not copied (not imported by the b18c384nbt conv-net path): train/fused_rope.py and train/fused_swiglu.py (Triton kernels,
imported lazily only by transformer configs), game/data.py (needs sgfmill), and the training / export scripts.

Use: put third_party/katago/python on sys.path (hs_lib.py does this) and `import katago...`.
